name: Honda Gold Wing GL1500
engine: 1520 cc liquid-cooled flat six, two carbs, shaft drive
intro: The six-cylinder Wing. Very tough. Starter clutch and charging parts are the usual wear items.

add.title: Check the starter clutch
add.instructions: If the starter grinds or spins without engaging, the starter clutch is worn or sticky.
add.reason: The starter clutch is one of the most common GL1500 complaints.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Starter clutch
known.what: The starter clutch can wear and cause grinding or slow engagement.
